task: Integrate Headroom context compression into the CodeMie backend with per-assistant, per-workflow and per-workflow-node configuration via a LangGraph pre_model_hook (sidecar or in-process SDK), including persistence, YAML schema, feature flag, deployment, docs and tests.

key_reasoning.reason: New service/headroom package (~8 modules: models, resolver, strategies, compressor protocol, sidecar and SDK compressors, factory, hook) plus LangGraphAgent hook chain (single and supervisor), AssistantService.build_agent / build_agent_for_workflow, AssistantExecutionOptions with three call sites, WorkflowConfigBase/WorkflowAssistant parsing, and workflow router YAML handling. New external service integration (sidecar) and new abstractions.

Closest patterns are the history-compaction and image-artifact pre_model_hooks and hedging_config/pool_config persistence, but none covers a sync network call or native SDK inside a graph node, fail-open behavior, or message-shape handling (list content, image blocks, handoff metadata). Gaps: AIToolsAgent/Bedrock/A2A-remote silent no-op, structured-output bypass, Claude prompt-cache invalidation. Workflow YAML rewrite on save drops top-level keys and the fix (EPMCDME-15759) is not on this branch, a prerequisite. Spike items (Linux wheel, sidecar lossless mode, offline SDK) are unresolved. Conversation content is sent to a sidecar (data-handling and token concerns). Edge-case tables for strategies and message shapes have no existing parameterized test template.

About 15 modified source files (langgraph_agent, assistant_service, workflows/utils, agent_node, workflow, assistant.py, workflow_config, workflow_models, routers/workflow, execution_config_schema.yaml, config.py, customer-config.yaml, docker-compose.yml, pyproject/lock, AGENTS.md) plus 8+ new package modules, an alembic migration, a guide doc and about 9 new test areas.
New headroom-ai dependency (Rust core, ~15 MB wheel, pins litellm>=1.96.2,<2.0 so transitive conflict possible), new docker sidecar image, new settings, license allow-list entry and /sanity handoff.

Agent runtime/Service, API models, DB persistence (two JSONB columns plus migration), validation/schema, Infrastructure (docker-compose, config, feature flag) and External integration (Headroom sidecar/SDK); cross-cutting config precedence node > workflow > assistant.

red_flags_applied: Integration with new external service (Headroom sidecar): Component Scope and Affected Layers already scored XL, no further bump (cap on judgment, not double counted)
Changes database schema (two nullable JSONB columns): Affected Layers and Technical Risk reflected at L/XL
Borderline 26/27: leaned higher because Component Scope is XL

split_recommendation.ordering_note: Single repo (codemie backend): foundation package first, then assistant-scope wiring, then workflow/node-scope config (which also depends on the workflow YAML save fix from EPMCDME-15759).
